authorized_request: Human requested 进行实验; advance independent v5 data preflight while earlier unspecified model clarification remains unresolved.
scope: Only all78 pinned development RGB files. No labels, features, model changes, training or held-out payloads.

timeline.source: Actual MP4 packet PTS then sparse independently decoded presentation frames; rational arithmetic.
timeline.sorting: Presentation PTS sorted once; packet DTS must strictly increase, PTS unique, no missing/synthesized PTS.
timeline.mapping_gate: First actual presentation time0; actual nominal60fps and exact1/60-second PTS increments. Otherwise DATA_PREFLIGHT_REJECTED: no inferred alignment or recording replacement.
timeline.annotation_numeric_mapping: floor(actual selected presentation seconds*30), not raw60fps IDs. Labels/end-frame inclusion/label-origin semantics remain unverified; no task readout until resolved.

sampling.selection: latest actual presentation frame at or before requested clock; lag<=1/30sec
sampling.eligibility: All256 observations supported; no padding or concatenation. Stop scientific continuation if any planned participant lacks an eligible recording.

decode_probes.per_recording: 0s,1/120s,0.5s and each eligible episode first/last observation; common deterministic times, no content/loss selection.
decode_probes.independent_check: Actual selected decoded frame PTS must equal nearest-past frame from packet timeline. Later decoded search-terminating frames discarded.
decode_probes.limit: Sparse decode checks do not establish full-frame decoding integrity; full encoding must retain timestamp/corruption checks.

decoder.installation: Same existing HPC Python. Immutable wheel extracted to separate data-only vendor directory; original Python environment unchanged; all extracted bytes checked against wheel before import.
decoder.requires: CPython3.11+ x86_64 glibc>=2.28; actual runtime3.11.17/glibc2.34 verified.

budget.first_recording_projection: elapsed first prespecified recording*78; stop if projected>3300s; no extra budget or easier sample substitution.

outputs: Compact scalar/runtime/hash/episode and sparse probe metadata only. No video, image, feature arrays, or weights transferred to Mac.
decision: PTS_AND_ELIGIBILITY_VERIFIED_ANNOTATION_LABELS_PENDING or DATA_PREFLIGHT_REJECTED or STOPPED. Never Phase1GO or model/reader evidence.
failure_policy: Preserve actual partial report/logs and scheduler state; inspect source and actual input proof before any recovery.
